formats.key: addLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 amountADesired,uint256 amountBDesired,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes up to amountADesired of tokenA from the signer and sends it to the pair (at least amountAMin).
Takes up to amountBDesired of tokenB from the signer and sends it to the pair (at least amountBMin).
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens of the pair to `to`; the amount depends on pool reserves.
Creates the pair if it does not exist yet.
formats.shown: The screen shows only "Add Liquidity", a maximum for token B, minimums for both tokens, the recipient and the deadline; the maximum of token A is hidden.

findings.title: addLiquidity hides amountADesired, so the maximum amount of token A that leaves is never shown
findings.evidence: Descriptor addLiquidity field {"path":"amountADesired","label":"Maximum to Add","format":"tokenAmount","params":{"tokenPath":"tokenA"},"visible":"never"}. UniswapV2Router02.addLiquidity: TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(tokenA, msg.sender, pair, amountA); _addLiquidity sets amountA = amountADesired when amountBOptimal <= amountBDesired. Case 0: signer sends 21941.065433837393688818 CARROT out; the screen shows only 'Minimum to Add 21392.538797991458846597 CARROT'.
findings.fix: Remove "visible": "never" from the amountADesired field so it shows as 'Maximum to Add' with tokenPath tokenA.

findings.title: addLiquidity interpolatedIntent references hidden amountADesired, and the wallet falls back to the bare 'Add Liquidity'
findings.evidence: Descriptor: "interpolatedIntent": "Add up to {amountADesired} and up to {amountBDesired} as liquidity" while amountADesired is visible never. Case 0 screen intent is only "Add Liquidity", with no amounts or tokens.
findings.fix: Make amountADesired visible so the sentence renders: "Add up to {amountADesired} and up to {amountBDesired} as liquidity".

findings.title: addLiquidity shows one 'Maximum to Add' and two 'Minimum to Add' fields, and the reader could not pair them
findings.evidence: Case 0 screen: 'Maximum to Add 435.835228 USDC', 'Minimum to Add ... CARROT', 'Minimum to Add ... USDC'. The reader notes: 'The screen lists two minimums (CARROT and USDC) and one USDC maximum, which is confusing'.
findings.fix: Show amountADesired and order the fields as max A, min A, max B, min B.

cases.notes: CARROT out 21941.07 is above the shown minimum 21392.54. The maximum is hidden, so the reader only knew 'at least'. USDC out 435.835228 matches the shown maximum. UNI-V2 LP in goes to the signer, as shown by Recipient, but the LP token and amount are not stated.

formats.key: addLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 amountTokenDesired,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Takes up to amountTokenDesired of the token from the signer and sends it to the pair (at least amountTokenMin).
Takes up to msg.value ETH, wraps it to WETH and sends it to the pair (at least amountETHMin).
Refunds unused ETH to the signer.
Mints UNI-V2 LP tokens to `to`.
formats.shown: Add up to the token amount and up to the ETH value as liquidity, with minimums, recipient and deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidity(address tokenA,address tokenB,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountAMin,uint256 amountBMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Moves `liquidity` UNI-V2 LP tokens from the signer to the pair and burns them (uses an existing allowance).
Sends at least amountAMin of tokenA and at least amountBMin of tokenB to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the two token minimums, with recipient and deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETH(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Moves `liquidity` UNI-V2 LP tokens from the signer to the pair and burns them.
Sends at least amountTokenMin of the token and at least amountETHMin of native ETH (unwrapped from WETH) to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the token minimum and the ETH minimum, with recipient and deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline)
effects: Moves `liquidity` UNI-V2 LP tokens from the signer to the pair and burns them.
Sends the router's whole token balance to `to`; amountTokenMin is checked before the token's transfer fee.
Sends at least amountETHMin native ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the ETH minimum and the token minimum before token fees, with recipient and deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermit(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's permit to set the router's LP allowance to `liquidity` or to unlimited (approveMax).
Moves `liquidity` UNI-V2 LP tokens from the signer to the pair and burns them.
Sends at least amountTokenMin of the token and at least amountETHMin ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the token and ETH minimums, with the LP approval scope, recipient and deadline.

formats.key: removeLiquidityETHWithPermitSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(address token,uint256 liquidity,uint256 amountTokenMin,uint256 amountETHMin,address to,uint256 deadline,bool approveMax,uint8 v,bytes32 r,bytes32 s)
effects: Uses the signer's permit to set the router's LP allowance to `liquidity` or to unlimited (approveMax).
Moves `liquidity` UNI-V2 LP tokens from the signer to the pair and burns them.
Sends the router's token balance to `to` (minimum checked before fees) and at least amountETHMin ETH to `to`.
formats.shown: Remove the LP amount for at least the ETH minimum and the token minimum before fees, with the LP approval scope, recipient and deadline.
